title: Frost Prince
summary: Cast level 1 Ice Knife once per Long Rest.

fields.Ice Knife: Action once per Long Rest. Make a ranged spell attack up to 60 ft away for 1d10 Piercing on a hit. The shard explodes even on a miss. Creatures in the 7 ft radius make a Dexterity save against your spell save DC or take 2d6 Cold. A successful save avoids the explosion damage.
fields.Surface: Leaves Ice in a 7 ft radius for 2 turns. Ice halves movement speed. Traversing it calls for a separate Dexterity save against Prone for 1 turn.
fields.Acquisition: Gilded chest in the southeast Ruined Battlefield.
fields.Casting while Silenced: The spell can be cast while Silenced.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
